finding: All 4797 checklist-backed 2006 Greats of the Game catalog rows sit on the bare key greats-of-the-game, in BOTH the setKey field and the id stem. R51 amended keys the product to fleer-greats-of-the-game.
rulings: R51 AMENDED (Drew, 2026-09-18): the 2006 Greats of the Game keys as `fleer-greats-of-the-game`. The product prints NO MAKER - 4,796 of 4,797 rows spell the setName '2006 Greats of the Game' - which is why the original R51 attribution to Upper Deck was sent back: the 2006 `upper-deck` pool holds ZERO rows titled Greats of the Game.

THE RULED AXIS IS setKey ONLY. Segment 4 of the id moves from `greats-of-the-game` to `fleer-greats-of-the-game`; sport, year, cardNumber, parallel, auto and every trailing segment carry through byte-identical. A reviewer should see exactly one segment change on every row.

YEAR-GATED AT THE VOCABULARY, and this list respects the same gate. The bare key is NOT 2006-only: it also carries ONE row each in 2000, 2001, 2002 and 2004 - `bccp-product-structure` stubs with no player, no card number and no hiq id (`product-structure:2001-greats-of-the-game`). They are NOT in this list and are NOT re-keyed: they stand in for products whose checklists are still an open acquisition (2001/2002 are #2234's subject), and a ruling about 2006 does not get to attribute four other years.

DESTINATION IS REGISTERED AND A FIXED POINT: `fleer-greats-of-the-game` was registered in #2232 with an explicit pattern ahead of the /fleer/ catch-all, so the moved rows resolve to themselves rather than collapsing back to bare `fleer`. Without #2232 this list would be a no-op that looked like a success.

reslug in this lane MOVES the row (copy, re-point that row's sales, retire the old slug's graded children, delete the old row) and REFUSES a destination occupied by a different card rather than merging. 3 pool rows currently sit on the 2006 bare slug and follow the move.
